name_original: Apple - USB-C Digital AV Multiport Adapter - White
description_original: The USB-C Digital AV Multiport Adapter lets you connect your MacBook with USB-C port to an HDMI display, while also connecting a standard USB device and a USB-C charging cable. Mirror your MacBook display to your HDMI-enabled display in up to 1080p at 60Hz or 4K Ultra HD resolution.
